result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer stops it from being written. I compiled the `reports` module, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a renamed config, so the rename case is untested.

In `DataExporter.java`, the hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The export now builds the five names for main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`. That is the same helper that writes the loose text files.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. The old failure came from reading a file that was never written under the fixed name. Since that no longer happens, `git-history.zip` should be written too when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I left `LandscapeAnalyzer.java:283` alone. It also hard-codes `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, but it wasn't part of this task.
